notes.title: 1.5.0 Update
notes.notes:
System Updates
- Added \[Gift], allowing you to gift pink or higher quality items by spending Soul Stones

- Increased the number of weapons in a deck to 15

- Added one-click medicine

- Added automatic chest opening

- Improved economy in ranked mode

- Adjusted the mechanics of some enemies in stages


Character Adjustments
- \[Song Jiang] Reworked

- \[Jie Zhen] Reworked

- \[Jie Bao] Reworked

- \[Yang Chun] Reworked

- \[Zhu Wu] Reworked

- \[Xiang Chong] Reworked

- \[Ruan Xiaoer] Reworked

- \[Ruan Xiaoqi] Increased health cost when skills activate

- \[Tang Long] Adjusted to unlock an additional weapon slot

- \[Zhang Qing] Increases attack power and health when injured

- \[Song Wan] Increases attack power and health when armor is gained

- \[Duan Jingzhu] Adjusted to gain damage reduction before the start of the round, price reduced by 1

- \[Du Xing] Price reduced by 1

- \[Zhang Shun] Base Attributes reduced from 6-12 to 4-10

- \[Zheng Tianshou] Health reduced from 12 to 10

- \[Wu Song] Plunder attack power reduced by 1, plunder health reduced by 2%

- \[Liu Tang] Mechanism attack power increased, health reduced

- \[Ruan Xiaowu] Mechanism damage increased from 2 to 4


Weapon Adjustments
- \[Plague Dagger] Increased poison stacks

- \[Catalytic Shield] Increased damage reduction

- \[Beast Bone - II] Price increased from 5 to 6

- \[Beast Bone - III] Price increased from 7 to 9

- \[Carved Feather Wooden Bow - I] Damage bonus reduced from 30% to 25%

- \[Carved Feather Wooden Bow - II] Damage reduced from 60^ to 50%

- \[Hook Spear] Price increased from 10 to 12

- \[Speculation Blade] High-quality attributes increased, price increased

- \[Yang Zhi's Pudao] Strength increased from 1 to 2, price increased from 2 to 4


Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue with \[Gu Dasao]'s health recovery when the mechanism is triggered

- Fixed an issue where the attack order would be disrupted if a teammate in the back died first.

- Fixed an issue where Wu Song's combination with Gourd wouldn't work.

- Fixed an issue where the Heavenly King's Tower only absorbed 2 HP.

- Fixed an issue where the collection's assembly slot was full, preventing assembly.

- Fixed an issue where the initial deck would be used with a certain chance.

- Fixed an issue where two cards could be opened in the Speed ​​Race card pool when only one card was left.

- Fixed an issue where the equipment order was changing.

- Fixed an issue where red cards wouldn't disassemble.

notes.title: 1.4.2 Update
notes.notes:
Character Adjustments
- \[Xiang Chong] Rework

- \[Sun Erniang] Increased the number of stages of absorption

- \[Lu Zhishen] Increased the initial value

- \[Hu Yanzhuo] Increased the initial value

- \[Hua Rong]'s attacks now take a portion of the victim's damage, and its attack power has been reduced from 10 to 8

- \[Wu Song]'s health plundered has been changed from a fixed value to a percentage, and its bloodlust increases as it takes damage

- \[Lu Junyi]'s mechanic effect has been increased from 25% to 50%, and its star upgrade effect has been significantly improved

- \[Wu Yong] and \[Song Jiang]: When triggering a rebellion, the rebellious unit will now be at the front of the team

- \[Song Jiang]'s price increased from 3 to 4

- \[Gongsun Sheng]'s clone now appears at the front of the team, and its price increased from 3 to 4

- \[Gu Dasao]'s price reduced from 3 to 2


Weapon Adjustments
- \[Tianwang Tower] Rework

- \[Gourd]'s mechanic has been added, and it now increases maximum health


Enemy Adjustments
- Minor adjustments to the mechanics of Lu Qian and Sun Erniang

- Weapon changes for Jiang Menshen and Xue Ba


Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where Huang Xin and Lin Chong's Hook Spear wasn't triggering.

- Fixed an issue where clicking the battle button in ranked matches wouldn't work.

notes.title: 1.4.0 Update
notes.notes:
### System Adjustments

- Added Advanced Mode \[Racing Treasure Hunt - I]

- Adjusted the economic curve, increasing early game damage and reducing late game damage

- Reduced enemy stats in the first chapter of each Advanced Level

- \[Weakness] now reduces damage based on stacks, up to 90%

- \[Vulnerability] now increases damage based on stacks

- Adjusted the mechanics of \[Catalysis], now adds poison stacks based on stacks

### Hero Adjustments

- Added \[Earth Evil Star - Huang Xin] \[Heaven Retreat Star - Lei Heng] \[Heaven Full Star - Zhu Tong] \[Earth Level Star - Cai Fu] \[Earth Consumption Star - Bai Sheng]

- Reworked \[Song Jiang] mechanics

- Reworked \[Wu Song] mechanics

- \[Lu Junyi] can now gain a portion of the health of the deceased

- Increased the price of \[Guan Sheng] from 3 to 4

- Increased the maximum number of resurrections for \[Chai Jin], reduced the price from 4 to 2

- Reduced the price of \[Hua Rong] from 4 to 3

- Reduced the price of \[Shi Jin] from 4 to 3

- \[Li Kui] HP cost when attacking has been increased from a fixed value.

- \[Qin Ming] Price reduced to 3

- \[Lu Zhishen] Price reduced to 3

- \[Duan Jingzhu] Reworked

- \[Yang Chun] Price reduced from 3 to 2

- \[Hu Sanniang] Mechanic adjusted: from increasing overall strength to increasing the number of buffs upon star upgrade

- \[Zhou Tong] Armor bonus reduced upon star upgrade

- \[Jie Zhen] Poison stacks increased to 4

- \[Jie Bao] Poison stacks increased to 5

- \[Song Wan] HP increased from 16 to 18

- \[Du Xing] Increased knockback limit, price reduced to 2

- \[Xuan Zan] Price reduced to 3, mechanic value reduced from 2 to 1

- \[Tao Zongwang] Poison stacks increased from 1 to 2

- \[Wang Ying] Increased vulnerability stacks upon star upgrade

- \[Zhu Tong] Increased weakening stacks upon star upgrade

### Weapon Adjustments

- \[Poison Explosion Dagger] Poison stacks halved after triggering a poison explosion, price reduced from 3 to 2

- \[Beast Bone] has been adjusted from granting all bonuses to higher quality buffs that buff more players.

- \[Resurrection Orb] mechanics have been adjusted, now restoring health based on the character's base health upon resurrection.

- \[Stonegrass] Price reduced from 4 to 2, stack count increased from 1 to 2.

- \[Killing Stick] Price reduced from 4 to 2, stack count increased from 1 to 2.

- \[Blank Axe] High-quality stats increased.

- \[Mixed Iron Shield] High-quality stats increased.

- \[Dog Skin Plaster] High-quality stats increased.

- \[Carved Feather Wooden Bow - I] Bonus reduced from 50% to 30%.

- \[Carved Feather Wooden Bow - II] Bonus reduced from 100% to 60%.

- \[Poison Dagger] Poison stack count reduced by 1, price reduced.

- \[Gourd] Price reduced.

- \[Greatsword] Price reduced.

- \[Mace] Price reduced.

- \[Subduing Tiger Whip] Price reduced.

- \[Spiked Shield] Price reduced.

- \[Water-Grinded Zen Staff] Price reduced.

- \[Catalytic Shield] Price reduced.

- \[Wooden Shield] Price reduced.

### Medicinal Material Adjustments

- \[Wawa Guo] All quality prices increased by 1

### Bug Fixes and Optimizations

- Fixed an issue where Zhang Qing, Xu Ning, Bai Sheng, and Huang Xin could not correctly trigger the Poison Dagger.

- Fixed an issue where Bai Sheng's Speculation Blade wouldn't trigger multiple times when attacking Bao Xu.

- Fixed an issue where the shop would refresh after a major quit.

- Fixed an issue where a new account could directly upgrade to a higher level on the same computer.

- Increased resolution.

- Increased scroll speed on the collection screen.

- Sorted all items in the collection by rarity and price.

- Optimized an issue with delays when clicking on cleared treasure chests.

- Optimized an issue where network errors prevented rewards from being claimed.

- Redrawn some weapon icons.

- Redrawn character images for \[Shi Qian] and \[Tang Long].

- Optimized collection screen loading speed.

- Reworked the difficulty selection screen art.

notes.title: v1.0.1 Beta Test Update
notes.notes:
Story Mode
- Added the fourth chapter \[Blood on the Yuanyang Tower]

- Added advanced modes: Standard, Difficult, Catastrophic, Abyss

- Adjusted loot, with the improvement of advanced modes, the quantity and quality of loot will increase

- Added new characters: \[Wu Yong], \[Zhang Qing], \[Zheng Tianshou], \[Liu Tang], \[Zhu Wu], \[Du Xing], \[Zhang Qing], \[Sun Erniang], \[Shi Qian], etc.

- Added weapons: \[Hooking Spear], \[Wooden Bow], \[Beast Bone], \[Blood-drinking Sword], \[Blade of Speculation] and higher quality of various weapons

- Added medicinal materials: higher quality of various medicinal materials


Ranked Matches
- Added Continue Challenge

- Now the enemy will attack first in battle

- Increased daily win limit for the first place


Systematic Adjustments
- All player data reset

- The upper limit of the character's medicine intake is 9

- Pink and orange level items are no longer available for synthesis

- Items that are not owned are no longer available for synthesis

- High-level story mode requires soul stones to be consumed before it can be challenged

- Soul stones return to one third of the original when items are decomposed

- Soul stones for clearing chapters are greatly reduced

- First pass soul stones are also provided for advancement

- Ranked games increase soul stone rewards for 3 wins per day

- Ranked games increase soul stone rewards for consecutive wins


Balance adjustments
- \[Zhang Shun], random teammate inheritance changed to first-ranked teammate inheritance

- \[Mu Hong], price increased from 1 to 2

- \[Bai Sheng], health increased from 4 to 6, rarity increased to rare (purple)

- \[Jie Zhen], three-star poison layers reduced from 4 to 3

- \[Jie Bao], star-up poison layer bonus adjusted to +1/+2

- \[Marrow Cleansing Fluid], \[Great Sword], \[Water-Grinded Zen Staff], \[Qin Ming's Mace] have their values ​​weakened

- \[Iron Bone Fan] price increased by 1, high-level version threshold increased

- \[Wooden Shield] value increased
